summary: Centers content with a token-based max width and fluid horizontal padding (mobile-first).
whenToUse: Main content of public pages and portals.
Long text: size="prose" limits line length (~70 characters).
whenNotToUse: Inside a Card or Dialog that already has padding: use disableGutters or no Container.
inherits: Global HTML attributes and events; ref to the element.
accessibility: No role added; use as="main" only once per page (AppShell already does this).
responsive: Horizontal padding grows with the viewport (space.4 → space.8); at 320 px the content does not overflow.
commonMistakes: Nesting multiple Containers: the effective width is that of the narrowest one and the padding adds up.
